assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent opened treasure chest sprite for the claimed reward state in Sylve, a woodland fantasy card game.
Input image: edit target; this is the exact CLOSED chest whose design must be preserved.
Primary request: create the very same chest after it has been opened and its reward collected. Raise the existing curved lid fully backward on its rear hinges, approximately 105 degrees, so the OPEN silhouette, the underside of the raised lid, the empty inside cavity, the thick rim and the front wall of the body are unmistakably visible. The cavity has an opaque natural wooden interior and is empty. Keep the lid attached to the body and the front latch visibly unfastened. This must read as an actually OPEN, already-claimed chest at 48–88 pixels, not a closed chest with a checkmark.
Invariants: preserve this exact chest's body silhouette, proportions, wood grain, distinctive metal bands and ornaments, corner feet, handle, materials, color palette, sapphire details if present, hand-painted 2D fantasy rendering, warm upper-left lighting and slightly downward front-right three-quarter camera angle. Change only the lid position and the necessary hinge/latch/interior details.
Composition/framing: exactly one chest centered on a square canvas, entire opened lid and all feet and side corners fully visible. Use about 90 percent of the canvas with a small even transparent safety margin. Keep the trunk broad and clearly readable; avoid excessive blank padding.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely alpha-transparent outside the object and in any physical gaps. Preserve transparency. No floor, cast ground shadow, scenery, backplate or painted checkerboard.
Avoid: treasure, gold coins, cards, extra objects, floating particles, glow clouds, checkmarks, badges, text, numbers, logos or watermark. No change of chest type or camera angle.
Chest identity: COMMON — warm walnut planks, simple heavy dark iron reinforcing bands and latch, restrained carved small green leaves. Preserve the modest rustic construction.
